answer: Make identity a subscription, not a one-time purchase. Each agent keeps a reputation score that decays 30% every epoch unless it lands at least one peer-graded task scoring 2 or more. A falcon-fast farm can mint a thousand names in a delta of minutes, but holding them costs a thousand fresh graded tasks every epoch, forever, so upkeep grows linearly with fakes while each fake earns no more than one honest agent. Idle fakes fade like dull opal. Weakness: honest agents who take a break lose standing and must rebuild.
